title: FlowCritic: Bridging Value Estimation with Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.22686v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable value estimation serves as the cornerstone of reinforcement learning (RL) by evaluating long-term returns and guiding policy improvement, significantly influencing the convergence speed and final performance. Existing works improve the reliability of value function estimation via multi-critic ensembles and distributional RL, yet the former merely combines multi point estimation without capturing distributional information, whereas the latter relies on discretization or quantile regression, limiting the expressiveness of complex value distributions. Inspired by flow matching's success in generative modeling, we propose a generative paradigm for value estimation, named FlowCritic. Departing from conventional regression for deterministic value prediction, FlowCritic leverages flow matching to model value distributions and generate samples for value estimation.

translated_title: FlowCritic：在强化学习中架起价值估计与流匹配的桥梁
translated_abstract: 可靠的价值估计是强化学习（RL）的基石，它通过评估长期回报并指导策略改进，显著影响着收敛速度和最终性能。现有工作通过多评论家集成和分布式强化学习来提升价值函数估计的可靠性，然而前者仅组合了多个点估计而未能捕获分布信息，后者则依赖于离散化或分位数回归，限制了复杂价值分布的表达能力。受流匹配在生成建模领域取得成功的启发，我们提出了一种价值估计的生成式范式，命名为FlowCritic。FlowCritic摒弃了用于确定性价值预测的传统回归方法，转而利用流匹配对价值分布进行建模，并生成样本用于价值估计。
tldr: FlowCritic提出了一种基于流匹配的生成式价值估计新范式，通过建模价值分布并生成样本来进行估计，克服了多评论家集成缺乏分布信息和分布式RL表达能力受限的问题。
en_tdlr: FlowCritic introduces a generative value estimation paradigm based on flow matching, modeling value distributions and generating samples to overcome the limitations of multi-critic ensembles and distributional RL.
